name: igarcez
description: Ian Garcez's Claude Code plugins — planning, intelligence-layer tooling, and more

plugins.name: plan-md
plugins.description: Interview-driven implementation plans written for AI coding agents — create, list, review, execute

plugins.name: intel
plugins.description: Project intelligence layer manager — bootstrap, extend, and audit an intelligence/index.md index + intelligence/*.md topic files

plugins.name: merge
plugins.description: Merge a branch into the current branch, resolving conflicts intelligently — defaults to the remote default branch

plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: AI pull-request reviews — review a GitHub PR (or your own current branch via /self-review), then plan the fixes, keep a local report, or push inline review comments (beta)

plugins.name: no-comments
plugins.description: Deny code comments at write time — Claude rewrites the code with descriptive names and small named functions so the comment is redundant

plugins.name: prime
plugins.description: Prime a repository for quality software engineering — installs direction-focused intelligence topics for AAA tests, Clean Code, Clean Architecture, comment-free code, the boy scout rule, and the detected stack

plugins.name: prose
plugins.description: Writing rules for all output — chat replies, review comments, docs, changelogs, commit and PR bodies: lead with the point, state only what is in place, plain language per ISO 24495-1
